description: A fictional ~2100 future-world sandbox around the phased Grand River Foundation dam series and Mistveil City. First dam-and-city operation is targeted circa 2046; 2098 is an interim commissioning/expansion milestone, not final completion; 20-year build windows reflect supply-chain constraints, not physical limits; Mistveil targets ~80 million residents by 2100. The first 40–60 years aspire to 1,200–2,500 feet of cumulative head across distinct stages; 4,000 feet remains the long-range fictional aggregate target, not a real-world engineering claim or single-dam height.
